title: Grapher indicator render catalogue (frontend-owned)
description: Per-indicator render hints, owned by the frontend per ADR-0045. One row per indicator_id; rows are optional (absence == frontend defaults). DELIBERATELY SEPARATE from indicator-catalogue.schema.json (canonical data shape) to keep visualization out of storage. Hand-authored seed; future PRs may add admin tooling.

x-changelog.description: Initial grapher indicator render catalogue per ADR-0045 (grapher catalogue split). Carries chart_type, default_mode, renderer_rules[], facet_labels{} - the four render-coupled fields that previously lived in indicator-catalogue.schema.json and the legacy per-shard indicator.schema.json. Seeded from current canonical + legacy values; PR-A3b migrates readers; PR-A3c strips the fields from the canonical schemas.

U4 (chart-type switcher seam). Additive: (a) new optional `chart_types` array carrying the ordered list of feasible chart types for the indicator; reader prefers `chart_types[0]` over the singular `chart_type` (ADR-0047 reader-before-writer); (b) widen both `chart_type` (singular, deprecated alias) and `chart_types[]` enum to the full 12-member ChartType set documented in docs/reference/chart-index.md section 1, plus the deprecated `stacked-trend` literal retained for back-compat reading. New JSON authored in this PR uses `chart_types`; legacy singular survives until F2a/F2b consolidate the renderer set.

indicator_id.description: FK to either taxonomy/indicators.json (canonical) or legacy '<topic>/<id>' shard form.

chart_type.description: DEPRECATED in v1.1 (use `chart_types`). Singular default-chart hint retained for back-compat reading. When both `chart_type` and `chart_types` are present, readers prefer `chart_types[0]`. Enum widened in v1.1 to the full 12-member ChartType set (docs/reference/chart-index.md section 1) + the deprecated `stacked-trend` literal.

chart_types.description: Ordered list of feasible chart types for this indicator. `chart_types[0]` is the on-load default the switcher pre-selects; the rest are the additional segments offered when feasibleAt() intersects with this list. Added in v1.1 per plan section 16.3a + 21.9 (U4).

default_mode.description: Default display mode for stacked-trend (absolute or share-of-total).

renderer_rules.description: Controlled-vocab slugs binding renderer behaviour (e.g. 'no_rank_table'). Vocabulary lives in docs/concepts/indicator-naming.md.
